title: Local lab review/apply/undo through one promotion writer
context: Owner requested architecture for Lab > test > fine-tune > decide > apply, without transferring a 9 KB complete preset for a few Quiver edits.
outcome: Added pure per-subject diffs and three-way merging, a localhost authoring API, and a shared CLI/server promotion writer. Source labs save canonical working copies into the project, review only selected Sentry/cue edits, apply exact reviewed snapshots with source-revision checks, run checks/build, and support inverse review/undo with persisted recovery. Failed validation restores prior source if no external edit intervened. Other subjects and independent newer changes survive. Copy now emits a small human-readable changed-values summary; full JSON is under Backup / transfer. API guards host/origin/token/body/subject and is disabled for release/read-only serving. Browser storage is a fallback; project saves work even if its quota fails. The source server on port8155 was restarted with authoring enabled. Actual user defaults were not promoted. Coverage remains existing FX/audio/missile schema; drive/lock and scene controls are explicitly outside promotion pending consumer/schema work.
alternatives: Per-tab full-package overwrite would lose other subjects and stale-tab changes; selected-field three-way merging avoids that.
A second compact preset import format was not introduced; summaries are for human review, canonical JSON remains the stored/backup artifact.
The existing CLI idempotence test exposed the need to preserve successful no-op promotions after extracting the shared writer; that contract is retained.
evidence: npm test: 70 programs passed; authoring and CLI promotion tests also rerun after final writer changes.
npm run check: 20 pure-layer modules and existing module/kernel/assets/preset/log checks passed.
node scripts/browser-test.mjs --local-authoring: temporary-workspace save/review/apply/check/build/reload/undo passed, including quota-blocked browser storage and preserved unrelated edits.
npm run test:browser passed game/model/range flows; a changed select-value assumption in the compact-copy test was corrected and authoring coverage rerun on the nested release.
GET http://127.0.0.1:8155/__authoring/state: available true, actual defaults baseline and no undo receipt.
